criteria.detail: The wide and compact screenshots visibly place compact filter and selection controls in the Projects header; the passed end-to-end evidence and live Unread-preset observation support the complete seven-preset interaction.

The live Unread filter reduced the tree to the two matching bb-plugins families while the screenshots retain project/thread hierarchy plus distinct Unread and Working labels; the passed end-to-end coverage supports composition with host search.

Selection mode visibly exposes checkboxes, and live QA observed disabled Unread items with an explicit protection reason; passed unit, fault-injection, adapter, and end-to-end checks cover the full current/working/waiting/unread/pinned protection set, with a protected preview returning no token and invoking no deletion.

The selection screenshot visibly shows the selected count, All, Clear, delete, and cancel controls; live cancellation closed the dialog while retaining both the selection and thread, demonstrating predictable non-mutating cancel behavior.
The confirmation screenshot visibly shows one root, zero child agents, total one, the selected root title, Cancel, and a separate Delete permanently action; live cancellation mutated nothing.

Passed unit, fault-injection, adapter, and end-to-end evidence covers confirmation and partial outcomes; the revised regressions explicitly show that either adding or removing a quiet descendant after preview produces scope-changed with no deletion, while per-id skipped and failed outcomes are rendered and protected previews receive no token.

Live QA observed Naranja + selecting Naranja and focusing the wide prompt, and bb-plugins + at 390px closing the drawer, selecting bb-plugins, exposing Local/branch workspace controls, and focusing the prompt; the compact-create screenshot visibly corroborates that result.

The screenshots preserve the existing navigation, hierarchy, collapse affordances, status treatments, and compact drawer layout, while passed end-to-end evidence covers accessible controls and the established navigation, shortcut, split, menu, parking, and collapse behaviors.

The packet contains passing pure unit, fault-injection, adapter-contract, and end-to-end receipts plus a passing browser/screenshot receipt, and all four supplied real-browser images visibly cover wide, confirmation, compact-sidebar, and compact-create states.

summary: Passed: every acceptance criterion has outcome evidence from the passing automated receipts, live observations, and four inspected real-browser screenshots. The revised regressions close the exact-descendant-topology and retained-selected-family/per-id-outcome gaps without any real deletion during browser QA.
